name: Fabricators Supply
old_description: Fabricators Supply, LLC, is a full line steel service center based in West Point, MS. We offer our clients a large inventory, reliable service and competitive pricing. Our central location enables us to offer next-day shipping on most orders throughout the Southeast. Customers nationwide appreciate us for our processing capabilities and short lead times.
about:
Fabricators Supply, LLC operates as a full-line steel service center from West Point, Mississippi. The company describes itself as American owned and operated, supplying American-made steel. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in the available information.

The business maintains a large inventory of structural tube — described as one of the largest in the United States — along with channels, flats, angles, sheet, and plate. Processing capabilities include plasma cutting with beveling on material up to three inches thick and 10 by 60 feet in size, as well as painting, small fabrication, and miter cutting. Part sizes can reach 10 by 21.5 feet.

Customers nationwide use the company for plate processing and structural tube supply, with next-day shipping available on most orders throughout the Southeast. The firm does not specify particular industry sectors in its public materials.

Fabricators Supply emphasizes its domestic ownership and domestic steel sourcing as a point of differentiation, alongside short lead times and a broad stock range. The company announced an acquisition of Hardwick Company, though details were not provided.
